title: Set 182

sentences.ko: 아니야 아빠, 차 괜찮아. 지난주에 이상한 소리가 나긴 했는데 정비소에 맡겼더니 아무 문제 없대. 그러니까 차 봐 주겠다고 굳이 여기까지 운전해서 안 와도 돼.
sentences.text: No, Dad, the car's fine. It made a weird noise last week, but I took it in and they said it was nothing, so you really don't have to drive all the way over here to look at it.

alts.text: Dad, relax, the car's okay. Yeah, it was making a weird noise last week, but I got it checked and they said it's nothing. Seriously, you don't need to come all the way out here to look at it.
No, Dad, the car is fine. It made an unusual noise last week, but I took it to the mechanic and they said it was nothing, so you really do not need to drive all the way here to inspect it.

sentences.note: **took it in** 은 차를 정비소에 맡기다라는 뜻이에요. **all the way over here** 는 먼 길을 굳이 여기까지 온다는 느낌을 줘요.
sentences.situation: 부모님 안부 전화에서 잘 지낸다고 둘러대기

sentences.ko: 매번 11시에는 휴대폰 내려놔야지 하는데, 정신 차려 보면 갑자기 새벽 2시고 나는 아직도 누워서 화면만 넘기고 있어. 그래서 이번 주 내내 거의 커피로 버티고 있어.
sentences.text: I keep telling myself I'll put my phone down at eleven, but then it's suddenly two and I'm still lying there scrolling, so I've basically been living on coffee all week.

alts.text: Every night I'm like, okay, phone down at eleven. Then boom, it's two and I'm still in bed scrolling. I've pretty much been running on coffee all week.
I keep telling myself that I will put my phone down at eleven, but then it is suddenly two o'clock and I am still lying in bed scrolling, so I have essentially been relying on coffee all week.

sentences.note: **I keep telling myself** 는 스스로 계속 다짐한다는 뜻이에요. **living on coffee** 는 커피로 버틴다는 말이고, casual 의 **running on coffee** 도 같은 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 그러니까 너 금요일까지 회사에서 못 빠진다는 거지? 그럼 그냥 일정을 통째로 일주일 미루는 게 어때? 여행 절반을 너 기다리면서 보내느니 차라리 늦게 가는 게 나아.
sentences.text: Okay, so if you can't get off work till Friday, why don't we just push the whole thing back a week? I'd rather go later than spend half the trip waiting around for you.

alts.text: Wait, you can't get off till Friday? Let's just move it all back a week then. I'd rather go later than sit around half the trip waiting on you.
If you are unable to leave work until Friday, perhaps we should postpone the entire trip by a week. I would prefer to go later rather than spend half the trip waiting for you.

sentences.note: **get off work** 는 퇴근하다, 일에서 빠지다라는 뜻이에요. **push the whole thing back** 은 일정을 통째로 뒤로 미루다, **I'd rather A than B** 는 B 하느니 차라리 A 하겠다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 현장학습 메일 받았어? 월요일까지 20달러 내래. 우리 애는 어젯밤에야 말해 주더라. 너네 애도 말하는 거 깜빡했을 것 같은데.
sentences.text: Did you get that email about the field trip? They want twenty dollars by Monday, and my kid only told me about it last night, so I'm guessing yours forgot to mention it too.

alts.text: You see that field trip email? They need twenty bucks by Monday, and my kid didn't tell me till last night. Bet yours forgot to mention it too.

Did you receive the email regarding the field trip? They are asking for twenty dollars by Monday, and my child only told me about it last night, so I suspect yours may have forgotten to mention it as well.

sentences.note: **field trip** 은 현장학습, 견학이에요. **I'm guessing** 은 내 생각엔 ~인 것 같다는 가벼운 추측이고, casual 의 **twenty bucks** 는 20달러를 편하게 부르는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 살인 다큐 또 보는 건 안 돼. 그거 보고 나면 잠을 못 자. 지난번엔 네가 골랐으니까 이번엔 내 차례야. 웃긴 거 보고 싶어.
sentences.text: We are not watching another murder documentary, I can't sleep after those. You picked last time, so it's my turn, and I want something funny.

alts.text: Nope, no more murder documentaries, I can't sleep after those. You picked last time, so it's my turn, and I wanna watch something funny.
We will not be watching another murder documentary, as I cannot sleep after watching them. You chose last time, so it is my turn, and I would like to watch something humorous.

sentences.note: **We are not watching** 은 절대 안 본다고 딱 잘라 말하는 표현이에요. **it's my turn** 은 내 차례라는 뜻이에요.

reviewed: 1번 formal 의 Father 는 실제로 아빠를 부를 때 쓰지 않는 말이라 Dad 로 되돌리고 말투만 올렸습니다
1번 한국어가 아니야 아빠 하고 반말로 시작하다가 끝에서 오셔도 돼 로 존댓말이 섞여 있어 안 와도 돼 로 맞췄습니다
5번 formal 의 I would rather we did not 은 딱 잘라 거절하는 원문을 부탁처럼 눅인 것이라, 단호한 뜻이 살도록 We will not be watching 으로 고쳤습니다
